name: Thunderhorn's Report
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
narrative.objectives: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, no wonder there is such joy running through the streams of Mulgore. You have done a great service today. The wells provide much for not only our people, but to the wildlife we depend on for food, clothing, and companionship.It is my humble pleasure to honor Mull's request. Please, accept this token of my gratitude.

quests.name: Thunderhorn Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.

quests.name: Wildmane Totem
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Wildmane Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
